_doc: AIM-seq settings chosen on Jakarta only (2026-10-21; tuning log and numbers in README.md, section 'Jakarta tuning'). run_aimseq.py reads 'defaults' (then 'by_eps', nearest eps in log scale); explicit flags override. Selection rule: lowest Jakarta composite vs train (trajpe.metrics.composite_score) at eps 4, checked at eps 1, among variants that run in <= ~40 min on 2 cores; decoder variants compared on the same DP records (redecode.py).
